narrative:
Tuscarawas County has 56,479 registered voters, with 19.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 23.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 49.6%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 25.9 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.9% of registrants.
